statement: ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.dx f) = KdVPlan.P f ∧ KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P f) = KdVPlan.invD f
proof:
intro f
constructor
· funext k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.P, hk]
  · have hki : Complex.I * (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hk)
    simp only [KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.P, if_neg hk, KdVPlan.dx]
    exact inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hki (f k)
· funext k
  by_cases hk : k = 0 <;> simp [KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.P, hk]
